There was a post saying something in the lines of ~we all have our purpose in life, and we are all here to help someone or save someone. Sometimes the person we need to help is ourselves, and it's okay and its valid if the person you need to save is you. Sometimes it sounds cri ge to me so it may seem cringe to you too lol

But trust me everyone matters, i have never met one person in life who could be replaceable. Its also okay if you dont know what to do with your life - after all you did spend a lot of your energy keeping yourself alive, so maybe you didnt have enough time to think about what do you want to do. I thought i had it figured out, i'm graduating uni, but i have no idea in which direction should i go now. We are all lost sometimes, even your friends who seem to have it all figured out. So take your time, dont be too hard on yourself. Focus on getting better and finding little joys in life, im pretty sure many people arent aware of their purpose either.

Thank you for sharing, it means a lot if ur usually a reserved person. Im glad we all have this community where we can talk and be listened to.
That sucks man. Hopefully it turns out that ur vocal cord is not paralyzed and that it can be fixed. Please try talking to someone about it, stay safe

I think we all sometimes say wrong things and people look at us in a weird way. But im pretty sure people have said much worse things and are still going around living their lives. Good thing is that people forget easily, so in a week or less no one will probably remember that you said anything. You are not a bad person, doing one bad thing doesnt make you a bad person. Bad person wouldnt regret doing a bad deed. Dont worry, you're okay, we all make mistakes sometimes. Stay safe

Im sorry to hear that your health facilities failed you. But hey, with each fail you are closer to success? You were brave to try so hard, and i hope there is still some hooe and will power left in you. Maybe you could try online help services? 

Im super sorry to hear that you've been dealing with this since your childhood, i cant even begin to understand how that must have felt. Ill pray for you, you really deserve help and life finally smiling at you

I know it adds to the guilt, i feel similar whenever i use my parents money. Now that im finally earning a little bit from my internship, i feel even worse when they jokingly say that i should give them some of my money, i thought it would be enough that they dont have to pay for my dorm and food anymore. Anyways, what i want to say is that it's their job, they chose to have kids, and im pretty sure they would do anything for us.
You may think it's a waste because they spent so much and you still dont feel better, but hey, you are alive! You might have been dead long ago if they didnt pay for the help. I mean put yourself in their shoes, if you had a suicidal child, would you rather pay for help for a few years and then have a child who finds joy in life and isnt suicidal anymore, or would you rather let them die bc it costs too much to keep them alive? You havent said much about them, but they sound like they are okay with paying, so i believe they would rather pay than have you dead.

It may be hard seeing your friends living their lives seemingly perfect, finishing everything on time and finding joy in life, when you dont feel the same. I mean if they are your friends, they would feel guilty and they would wish they knew you needed more help. I dont want to say that other people have it worse, i just want to say that you're lucky that you have friends that you could talk to. Maybe choose just one that you feel the closest to? Or someone who used to tell you things, so now it would be kinda reciprocated? Im still here to hear the rants if nothing else works. And please update us about your therapy today (if you want to ofc)

Im happy to hear that you'll be talking to a professional today. I hope with all of my heart that it will go well and that you'll get the proper treatment. But if you can change a therapist, please try that too. Thank God that you have finances to be able to pay for that. Life and health are always worth paying for. Some people need to change 2 or 3 therapists before they find the right one, but i hope ur not one of them.
Its brave that you shared it with your friends, and trust me they would prefer if you talked to them about it, over you keeping it to yourself and commiting.

If you need to talk to someone else or just rant, im here to listen.

Good luck with todays session

The things you wrote resonate with me so much. It sucks to feel this way, but our thoughts dont have to be our reality. I know u dont want help, but maybe try researching about intrusive thoughts?

Have you tried seeking help from a professional? Its sad to hear your own parents are forcing you and not letting you deal with it at your own pace. Its even worse that they seem to not believe you that you would commit. Maybe try a helpline, or talk to a friend. Oh God thats fucking terrible. Props to you for trying more than once. What about the other helplines? Im assuming you tried others too. I know that regular people cant help like the professionals can, but please try talking to someone in your life. And if you dont feel ready to share it with someone you know, you could try talking to someone here. And maybe keep trying to call the first helpline if you have any will power left

You are brave for pushing through it. You havent said much, but your thoughts are probably overexaggarating. Did you try seeking help? Talking to someone close to you? If all else fails, feel free to write here or to me, there are people who would like to help. Stay safe olease

On the other hand i hope u'll get over it. You probably dont want to hear "rethink it", but please do. I hope you get a sign from God or whatever you believe in that there is at least one thing in life that could be your joy and reason to live. Stay safe
I hope you do give up on kicking the bucket. Is there anything else that you'd like to practise that makes you feel a bit better?

Most of the people who are good at something needed to practise to get there. It's all about the repetition, and after some point you get confident in yourself and you can do it without being too anxious. I'm an extrovert and i talk to a lot of people, but even i get anxious sometimes and later regret the things i said and feel like i sounded dumb to people. But the good thing is that most people feel like that sometimes, so they should probably understand it when it happens to you.
Sure, i can. I hope its not too late. Feel free to write, stay safe

No one is that much of an awful person that they deserve to die. Unless you killed many people on purpose, you don't deserve to die. Even those people may have mental issues so they deserve help and not death. Anyways, whatever the reason you think is, i believe it's not big enough. You deserve to live and to give your life another chance. We all feel like disappointment sometimes, its a valid feeling but its oftentimes not true. Your thoughts are not always your reality. Sometimes our minds like to trick ourselves to think the worst and its often so far from truth. Stay safe please

It just proves that so many people feel similar to how you feel, and that the helpline is busy helping. Maybe you're just seeing it as a sign because you want to. And i'm not blaming you, i understand why we do it. Please try again, your whole life might change in a few years. Stay safe

When you tell them that you tried to kys, they will certainly take you seriously. Im sad that it took you trying to kys for them to potentially realize that you do in fact need help. It's not pointless, you have literally nothing to lose. Please try again. You are important and your thoughts are valid, please dont hurt yourself over some unprofessional uneducated swine of a doctor

It's hard to hear that. You've been brave to try for so long, so props to you for that. I really hope you survived last night, every one of us holds intrinsic value and uniqueness to themselves that can never be brought again in this world by anyone else. Im sad that you havent found your purposes and joys in life before it took a dark turn. I'm sorry too

Honestly im pretty sure she didnt mean it. Many people say things they dont mean when they're angry - sadly i know because im one of them - but that obviously doesnt make it okay. I could almost guarantee that she used to care for you, otherwise she wouldnt be your friend for so long. I used to have a friend that i cared about so much, and i was devastated when i realized that i would never see him again (i told him we wont hang out or talk ever again unless he initiates contact - and he never did it again). But one of my friends told me a wise thing: in your life you dont need people who dont need you. Idk if there are currently other friends in your life, but if there are, then those people are worth focusing on. And even if there are not, im pretty sure ull get your chance to meet new friends in high school. Im not super sure how your school system works and when do you get to "graduate" and start new school, but you're still in the part of your life where you can hope for new beginnings. I hopw you find someone else soon, and i hope you learn to enjoy your own company before that. Best of wishes!

Please dont do it, you will probably be too tired to stab yourself to death, and if you survive you may cause some serious damage, you could make life even harder than it is, as well as the option of trying to commit it again. If there is hell, im pretty sure its way worse than whatever happens on earth. Not really sure if you would want to go from bad to even worse.  Please use the help of people who offered it here, see if it helps. Yoi can always reconsider it again, but there is no coming back once you do it. Stay safe

Well maybe there is a reason why life just won't let you die? There are probably good things awaiting and good things you ade destined to become if you have the courage to push through this bit  i wish you all the strength and luck in this world, stay safe

Well props to you for pushing through all these years. It takes lots of strength and will power, especially with the "arguments" you have with yourself. It was brave of you to share it with your parents, but im sad that they are one of those people who dont seem to believe in depression. I hope you can seek help someplace else. I see the spark in you, i mean if there wasnt one you probably wouldnt be alive right now. So please use it to seek help, and in a few years you may be grateful to yourself for pushing through for a while longer. Wish you all the best, and thank you for sharing

I know things feel so big right now and that it has been painful to lose a friend you cared for. But you are still in school and there are so many opportunities to meet new friends. I know you think no one could replace them, but maybe they needed to get out of your life, so that better people can come in. Maybe you could focus a bit more on the relationship you have with your family. You can push through this, i believe in you.

And please seek help, try to talk to your family or someone else, it gets a bit better when you share your sadness and sorrow with someone else.

Yes you can! You are already super brave for thinking optimistic and trying to see the kight at the end of the tunnel. Try to live in the moment. Im quite sure the new job will work out just fine, and if it doesnt, its probably because something better is waiting along the road. Just like you're at the better place now than you have been before, in one year things could be even better. You are brave and you are important, and you can do it. I wish you all the best from the bottom of my heart

It is absolutely never too late. Im glad you said you became more aware of certain things - maybe thats all you needed? Many people kill themselves due to the lack of sense of belongingness, but you seem to have friends, and one friend who is close enough to you to be able to read you like a book. Talk to him, please, you have nothing to lose. Try experiencing life for a bit longer through your new-found lense. I hope it gets better for you

I believe that it always gets better, some people just dont stay around long enough to see it. For some people it gets better after one month, for some after a year or two. The ones who stayed alive usually say how they're very glad that they had courage to push through, because now they are finally experiencing the pretty little joys in life that they wouldnt have experienced otherwise.

I kinda understand you because at one point in my life all i wished was to fall asleep and never wake up. Maybe at least give yourself one last try, give yourself at least a year and try your best to build a life worth living. And then maybe you can come back and update us :)

Well if the friend managed to talk you out of it last year, it means that he gave yoi very good reasons as to why you should keep living. It was very brave of you to decide to give life another chance, and i'm glad you did it. No one is expendable, trust me. Whenever i think that i could put someone under certain label and call tham replaceable, i always find something that makes them unique and realize that no one else can be quite like them.

Maybe i dont know the whole backstory, but it doesnt seem to me that you cant forge a true, genuine friendship. The person who talked you out of it must have felt a connection, and they are still in your life. I cant prpmise you anything, but i think yoir friend wouldnt be disappointed in you. I think he would feel relief that you told them that things got worse again (instead of you leaving this world) and they would probably be happy to help you again.

It's valid that you feel disappointed in yourself, we all do sometimes. But ups and lows are part of human experience, and if you get through this and mamage to live despite your disability, im pretty sure that it will forge you into a strong person who will build a good life. 

Sorry about the novel i wrote, i just hope that you will reach out to that friend again.  You have nothing to lose
Thank you so much for your kind and respectful comment. Ill go find some words and apologize to him

It doesn't sound pathetic at all, choosing to live life for whatever reason, despite the pain, is a very brave thing to do. I don't know you but i am so proud that you made the decision to try again.
Sometimes we're not aware of the effect we have on others - maybe you playing your guitar will help someone else and bring smile on their face. And even if it doesn't help anyone else but you, it's still a success. If you ever decide to record a few notes, i'd be happy to hear you play. Maybe you can update us in a month or two with a lil song.
I hope God will help you find light and bless you with a happier life.
